C1005.title: June 10 Special Enforcement Against 'Actor' Behavior Penalty Announcement
C1005.summary: Honor of Kings officials announced a crackdown on malicious 'actor' behavior, where players engage in win trading by colluding to manipulate match outcomes. Stricter penalties including leaderboard bans, leaderboard clearance, credit score deductions, and match bans have been imposed on identified accounts.

references.title: June 10 Special Crackdown and Penalty Announcement on 'Actor' Behavior
